method: group-disjoint ordinal isotonic calibration of fixed probabilities
base_predictions: fixed EfficientNet-B4 fold-assigned probabilities; source filename is retained for compatibility
group_column: subject_id (filename-derived grouping key; not a verified identity)
description: Each cumulative probability P(Y>=k) is calibrated on four partitions of filename-derived grouping keys and evaluated on the fifth; rows are projected to a valid decreasing cumulative distribution before conversion back to five-class probabilities. This is not end-to-end nested cross-validation or external validation.
